title: Vision Plans Lens Options: Photochromic and Tint Copay
content:
A light-control copay is added to a Vision Plans eyeglasses order when the lens options list a light-control treatment:

- **Photochromic listed:** the plan's photochromic copay.
- **Tint listed without photochromic:** the plan's tint copay.
- **Neither listed:** nothing (0.00).

Where both photochromic and tint are listed, only the photochromic copay is added.

Copays by plan (USD):

| Plan | Photochromic | Solid or gradient tint |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | 82.00 | 15.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | 82.00 | 15.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | 75.00 | 15.00 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | 70.00 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | 47.00 | 0.00 |

*Hypothetical cases on Cascade Vision Select 150.* Photochromic lenses carry 75.00. Tinted lenses carry 15.00. Lenses listing both carry 75.00. Lenses with neither carry 0.00.
